item.dc:creator: editor
item.description:

The Bay Area was a groundswell for experiments in communal living during the 1960s and ’70s. Few would associate the utopian spirit of those projects, which were often motivated by the desire to leave the city and its ills, with the urban encampments that have come to shape the region’s public landscape in more recent years.
